glosses: has been done (and left that way)
patterns.usage_note: Attaches to the te-form of a transitive verb and reports the lingering result of a deliberate act, very often a preparation made in advance (切符はもう買ってある); the doer usually goes unmentioned. The contrast to learn is intransitive + ている (窓が開いている, a bare state) against transitive + てある (窓が開けてある, a state someone arranged). Inserting a particle, as in てはある／てもある, turns the same frame into a concession or emphasis.

examples.ruby: テーブルには、二人分[ふたりぶん]のお箸[はし]が並[なら]べてある。
examples.english: Two sets of chopsticks are laid out on the table.

examples.ruby: 壁[かべ]には去年[きょねん]のカレンダーが貼[は]ってあった。
examples.english: Last year's calendar was still up on the wall.

examples.ruby: 連絡[れんらく]はしてはあるが、返事[へんじ]がまだ来[こ]ない。
examples.english: I did get in touch with them, it's just that there's still no reply.
